referenceFunction.generalComment: Refers to 1 kg dry matter of grass silage from intensive IP production with 1.65 kg CO2 and 17.9 MJ per kg dry matter. The dry matter content of grass silage is about 35% ; UUID: ca55e619-a69d-3077-9ff0-f322659bb465
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the production of grass for silage from 65% natural and 35% temporary meadows. Included steps are soil cultivation, pestizides against Rumex, fertilisation (slurry and mineral fertilizer), harvest, baling, loading and transport.
